# tools/budgets.txt — every size this tree asserts about its own builds, in
# one place. tools/build_mac.sh sources it; Python reads it through
# tools/budgets.py. What each figure is, and why it is asserted, is said where
# it is used; why one moved is the commit that moved it (git log -p on this
# file) and DECISIONS.md.
#
# The MEASURED figures are rewritten from the builds by tools/retake_budgets.py,
# which is the acknowledgement that they moved: run it, read what it prints,
# and say in the commit what the bytes bought. Do not edit them by hand. The
# MACHINE figures are the emulator's (tools/vmac/README.md) and the CEILINGS
# are decisions; retake_budgets.py moves neither.

# ---- MEASURED: resident CODE and A5 (data + bss) per configuration, the
# ratchets tools/build_mac.sh holds each build to
UNC_MAC_CODE_DEFAULT=198440   # the resident control (UNC_OVL_RESIDENT)
UNC_MAC_A5_DEFAULT=35160
UNC_MAC_CODE_EAGER=34168      # the shipped build
UNC_MAC_A5_EAGER=14024
UNC_MAC_CODE_LAZY=33316       # the lazy lifetime (UNC_OVL_LAZY)

# ---- MEASURED: what tools/run_tiers.py computes every budget from
TIERS_CONTROL=233600          # the control's CODE + A5
OVL_SAVED=185408              # the control's CODE + A5 less the shipped build's
BUNDLE=211076                 # ovl_bundle.bin
# Each image, ovl_<name>.bin
IMAGE_ARC=7924
IMAGE_BINHEX=7630
IMAGE_BTOA=2496
IMAGE_CODECS=6012
IMAGE_CPTDD=15244
IMAGE_CRYPT=9260
IMAGE_EXO=30284
IMAGE_LZH=10602
IMAGE_NOW=4948
IMAGE_PACKIT=2278
IMAGE_SPACESAVER=16236
IMAGE_STUFFIT=28818

IMAGE_SUPERDISK=6628
IMAGE_TEXT=11438
IMAGE_ZIPOLD=26070
IMAGE_SNIFF=18706
IMAGE_DESTDLG=1688
IMAGE_SEGSETUP=2830

# ---- MEASURED: what tools/check_app_size.py watches, within its tolerance
APP_CODE_FILE=40960           # MacExtract.code.bin
APP_BUNDLE_FILE=211076        # ovl_bundle.bin

# ---- MACHINE: measured on the emulator, not from a build
TIERS_MACHINE_SYS3_512K=414224   # System 3.0, Macintosh 512Ke
TIERS_MACHINE_SYS6_512K=318820   # System 6.0.8, Macintosh 512Ke
TIERS_MACHINE_FLOOR_1M=843108    # System 6.0.8, 1 MB Mac Plus
OVL_RESIDUE=-402                 # the shipped probes' budgets less the model's

# ---- CEILINGS: decisions, with headroom
UNC_MAC_A5_LAZY=19200
